# Drumland

> > Drumland is a Canadian drum shop and percussion retailer offering professional-grade instruments, gear, and drumming instruction.

Drumland specializes in drum kits, cymbals, percussion instruments, and related gear from major manufacturers including Drum Workshop, Tama, Yamaha, Pearl, and Roland. The shop provides both retail products and educational resources, including jazz drumming instruction and materials from renowned pedagogue Jim Blackley.
